sources.title: EU AI Act — transparency obligations (Art. 50)
sources.why: Requires telling users when an emotion-recognition system is scanning them or when they are interacting with a machine, curbing covert emotional influence.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 9 — biometrics (+ AI Act Art. 5)
sources.why: AI Act Art. 5 outright bans subliminal, manipulative techniques and exploitation of user vulnerabilities, the core of emotional manipulation and harmful nudging.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 22 — automated decisions
sources.why: Automated nudging that significantly affects users triggers safeguards and human oversight, limiting machine-driven influence over their choices.
